```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read_excel("C:/Users/A c e r/Downloads/dataset nilai ads.xlsx")
df <- df %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

# Pakai kolom berdasarkan index (AMAN)
RA <- df[[1]]
RB <- df[[2]]
RC <- df[[3]]

nilai <- c(RA, RB, RC)
nilai <- nilai[!is.na(nilai)]

summary(nilai)
sd(nilai)

set.seed(123)
sampling_means <- replicate(10000, mean(sample(nilai, size = 30, replace = TRUE)))

mean_sampling <- mean(sampling_means)
se_sampling <- sd(sampling_means)

hist(sampling_means,
     main = "Distribusi Sampling Rata-rata Nilai ADS",
     xlab = "Rata-rata Sampel",
     col = "lightblue")

boxplot(nilai,
        main = "Boxplot Nilai ADS (Semua Mahasiswa)",
        ylab = "Nilai Akhir",
        col = "lightgreen")

n <- length(nilai)
mean_x <- mean(nilai)
sd_x <- sd(nilai)
se_x <- sd_x / sqrt(n)

lower <- mean_x - 1.96 * se_x
upper <- mean_x + 1.96 * se_x

cat("CI 95% =", lower, "sampai", upper, "\n")

```
